title: Robertson panel directive to watch and infiltrate UFO groups

tellings.quote: and and again from the Robertson panel too the the directive was um let's keep an eye on UFO act uh groups

tellings.page: Part II, Unofficial Investigating Groups, pp. 1416-1417
tellings.quote: It was believed that such organizations should be watched because of their potentially great influence on mass thinking if widespread sightings should occur. The apparent irresponsibility and the possible use of such groups for subversive purposes should be kept in mind.

plain: A 1953 CIA panel of scientists, the Robertson Panel, is said to have directed that civilian UFO groups be watched and infiltrated. Robert Salas, a former Air Force officer, tells Michels the directive was "let's keep an eye on UFO groups," pointing to the panel's report of 16 February 1953. That report says such groups, naming the Civilian Flying Saucer Investigators and the Aerial Phenomena Research Organization, "should be watched because of their potentially great influence on mass thinking" and that "the possible use of such groups for subversive purposes should be kept in mind"; it does not say they should be infiltrated.

discussion.by: Report of Meetings of Scientific Advisory Panel on Unidentified Flying Objects (Robertson Panel), 14-18 January 1953
discussion.text: The panel's minutes say the civilian groups "should be watched", naming the Civilian Flying Saucer Investigators and the Aerial Phenomena Research Organization; they do not say the groups should be infiltrated.
